claims.text: The KDG model underwent pruning of spurious logical forms before training, which significantly improved its accuracy from 36.3% to 43.3%.
The pruning algorithm used in the KDG model eliminates spurious training data entries, which is crucial for achieving better performance in semantic parsing tasks.
